content.short: STON.fi is a TON decentralized exchange for token swaps, liquidity provision, and farming through non custodial AMM pools.
content.description: STON.fi is one of the main decentralized exchanges in the TON ecosystem, built around automated market maker trading and non custodial liquidity pools. Users can swap supported tokens, provide liquidity to pools, and join farming programs through its web interface. The protocol also offers APIs, SDKs, and developer documentation for teams building on top of its exchange infrastructure. Within TON, it serves as a core trading venue rather than a general wallet product or a simple token listing site.
content.meta: STON.fi provides TON swaps, liquidity pools, farming, and exchange infrastructure for users and developers building on the network.
